name: SaturationAwareBackgroundV2
scoring_rule: Use standardized band-22 residual when valid, otherwise band-21 residual. Separate prediction heads and observed-target masks; no radiance blending or saturated-value imputation.
development_rule: Within each training regional cohort/day-night stratum with at least two swaths, hold out max(1,floor(0.2*n)) whole swaths by seeded SHA-256 order. Add the inherited validation swath. No test inputs, VIIRS labels or MODIS fire flags determine the partition.
boundary_rule: Fit on the original disjoint halo=16 native interiors. Predict on native cells with a complete radius-10 context. Evaluate only the original known reference query centers, retaining invalid queries as undetected.
scope: Corrected unsupervised background model trained from scratch on existing local MODIS inputs. Original model and scores preserved. Benchmark has been examined and informed the saturation repair; this is development evidence, not a new blind test.
